workflow_runs.name: libpinmame
workflow_runs.display_title: Whirlwind: do not log the solenoid overlay's bytes as sound commands

head_commit.message:
System 11 sound overlay (Whirlwind): log the sound commands only

On Whirlwind (S11_SNDOVERLAY), pia5b_w() writes both the sound commands
and the bytes 00-1F that drive the solenoid overlay board; pia5cb2_w()
does not strobe the latter to the sound board. sndbrd_1_data_w() logged
every write, so the sound command log, AltSound and libPinMAME's sound
command callback got the overlay's bytes too: in attract mode thousands
of 1F, and 0F/05 when the overlay fires, which AltSound looks up as
sound commands 0x001F, 0x000F...

The data write log is now off for board 1 on these games, and pia5b_w()
logs the bytes that are not overlay bytes.
